frame.cadasio_frame: same as the GLB (component placements equal to 0.001 mm); Cadasio offsets are in each component's own axes

nano.note: the Nano inside the built module NAUO78 (34 meshes: nano-board, two 15-pin headers, chips, Mini-USB); NAUO94 has a node of the same name, which trimesh (stepgen.Model) loads as NAUO301_1 because NAUO78 comes first in the file
nano.loose_nanos: NAUO2 / NAUO3 are one mesh each (nano_Varsayilan, 296070 vertices), the same model as the MRA Nano NAUO126 (0.007 mm), hovering 44.90 / 15.24 mm straight above the bench module seat; neither is seated

io_module.source: MRA cad_pins.json pin tops (top of each male pin), carried by the exact MRA NAUO82 -> PMG transforms
